title: Inventory Control Center
lead: Stock, locations, counts, discrepancies and approvals in one place. Every balance change is a ledger movement; nothing is edited in place.

scope.countryHint: Change the country from the working context at the top of the app.

state.notSetUpBody: The database part of this section has not been installed for your company. Nothing is shown until it is, so no figure on this screen is invented.
state.deniedTitle: You do not have access to this
state.deniedBody: This needs the "{cap}" permission for inventory. Ask an administrator if you need it.
state.truncated: Showing the first 20,000 lines only. Narrow the site or country to see everything.

overview.naHint: N/A means the figure cannot be measured yet (the part is not set up, or the data is missing). It never means zero.
overview.rulesSub: Rules enforced by the database, not only by this screen

rules.noNegative: Physical stock can never go below zero. Shortages and backorders are recorded separately.
rules.blind: Counts are blind: the counter never sees how many the system expects.
rules.segregation: The person who counted cannot approve the adjustment.
rules.ledger: The ledger is append-only. Mistakes are corrected by a reversal, never by editing.
rules.erp: Financial postings stay in the ERP. Inventory creates no accounting entries.
rules.tyres: Each tyre has one custody state. Conflicts are investigated, never corrected automatically.
rules.currency: Values are shown per currency (SAR, AED, EGP) and never added together.

locations.title: Location hierarchy
locations.name: Name
locations.empty: No locations yet. Add a warehouse, then its zones and bins.
locations.readOnly: You can view locations. Adding or changing them needs an Admin, Manager or Director.
locations.labelSheetSub: Each label carries TP:LOC and the location id. Scan it on the phone to open that bin.
locations.noStores: No active store is registered for this country. Stores are managed in Site Management, not here.

tpl.label: Start from
tpl.containerHint: Left and right wall racks, 4 shelves, 5 bins
tpl.roomHint: Racks A and B, 4 shelves, 5 bins

bulk.title: Bulk rack, shelf and bin setup
bulk.sub: Describe the layout once. You see every code before anything is saved.
bulk.summary: This creates {racks} racks, {shelves} shelves and {bins} bins. {existing} codes already exist and will be reused.
bulk.previewNote: {created} new locations will be created at {site}. {existing} already exist and are kept as they are. Nothing is saved until you press Create.
bulk.more: {n} more rows are not shown here but are included.

errors.parent: The chosen parent is not in this list any more.
errors.parentSite: The parent belongs to another store.
errors.range: Check the range: the end must come after the start (at most 100).
errors.rackCode: Rack codes use letters, numbers, dot or underscore.
errors.nothing: Enter racks, shelves or bins to create.
errors.prefix: Enter a code prefix or rack codes so every code is unique at the store.
errors.codeFormat: A generated code is too long or uses a character that is not allowed.
errors.duplicate: Two generated codes are the same. Change the prefix or style.
errors.tooMany: At most {max} locations can be created at once.

errors.codeFormat: Use letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore (up to 40).
errors.codeTaken: This code is already used at this site.
errors.name: Enter a name.
errors.selfParent: A location cannot be inside itself.

movements.appendOnly: The ledger is append-only. A wrong movement is corrected by a reversal that points back to it.
movements.reverseBody: A new movement will cancel this one. The original stays in the ledger. A reason is required.
movements.reasonRequired: Enter a reason for the reversal.

audits.mine: Only audits I am part of
audits.newSub: The counter will count blind. The reviewer and approver must be different people from the counter.
audits.howItWorks: Start takes a snapshot of the expected stock. The counter counts blind, the reviewer reconciles, lines outside tolerance are recounted by someone else, then an approver decides each adjustment.
audits.noSnapshot: Not taken yet (taken when the audit starts)
audits.counterNote: You are the counter. You will not see expected quantities, and you cannot approve this audit's adjustments.
audits.noActions: There is nothing for you to do on this audit right now.

errors.sameReviewer: The reviewer must be a different person from the counter.
errors.duePast: The due date cannot be in the past.

count.blindBody: Count what is physically there. Expected quantities are hidden on purpose. Leave a line blank if you did not count it; tick Confirmed zero if the shelf is empty.
count.noLines: No lines were assigned to you for this audit.
count.extrasTitle: Found items not on the list
count.extrasBody: Add anything on the shelf that is not on your list. The reviewer will see it as unexpected.
count.confirmBody: After you submit you cannot change these figures. A recount, if needed, is done by someone else.
count.badQty: A counted quantity must be a number of zero or more.
count.badExtra: Each extra item needs a quantity above zero.
count.nothing: Enter at least one counted line before submitting.
count.extraItemUnknown: No item with this code was found. Check the code or label.
count.extraItemAmbiguous: More than one item uses this code. Use the barcode or ask the reviewer.
count.extraLocationUnknown: This location code is not part of this audit.
count.extraLocationAmbiguous: More than one location in this audit uses this code.
count.extraUnresolved: Some found items could not be matched. Correct the marked lines; nothing was sent.
count.partialRejected: {done} lines were saved. {rejected} lines were not accepted; they stay below with the reason. Correct them and submit again.

recon.netAbsHint: Net can hide offsetting losses, so the absolute variance is always shown beside it.
recon.noLines: No snapshot or count lines yet.
recon.recountBody: Assign a recount to a different person. Serial-tracked tyres have zero tolerance.

approve.noCapability: You do not have the adjustment approval permission.
approve.segregation: You counted, recounted or created this, so someone else must approve it.

disc.approvalSteps: Step 1: ask for approval of this adjustment. Step 2: another person decides it in Controls > Approvals. Step 3: post it below; the database refuses a post that was not approved or that changed after approval.
disc.recountSteps: A recount needs an approved request naming the recounter first. Request it, let another person approve it, then assign the same person.
disc.noAdjustmentYet: No adjustment has been raised for this discrepancy yet, so there is nothing to send for approval.
disc.recountBody: A recount is done by a named person who has not counted these lines. It is assigned here, not approved.
disc.readOnly: You can read this investigation. Changing it needs the discrepancy review permission.
disc.correctionPreview: Stock change on approval: {change} (book quantity at the count: {expected}).
disc.notProposed: Approval opens once a correction has been proposed.
disc.noteRequired: A note is required to reject or hold.

controls.permTitle: What you can do in inventory
controls.permSub: Based on your role and any personal grants
controls.serverNote: This list decides what the screen offers. The database checks every action again, so a refusal can still appear.
controls.noAutoMerge: Items that look like duplicates are reviewed one by one. Nothing is merged automatically.

opening.approvalFirst: Approving this batch needs an approved request from someone other than the preparer. Request it, let another person decide it in Controls > Approvals, then approve the batch.
opening.rule: Existing stock figures are not assumed correct. Load an opening balance as a batch: map the columns, check missing costs, submit, then someone else approves it.
opening.readFailed: The file could not be read.
opening.previewNote: Showing the first {shown} of {total} lines. All lines are saved in the batch.
opening.notSubmitted: Only a submitted batch can be approved.

issue.bad_cost: Cost is not a valid number

links.materialIssueSub: Issue and return against job cards

supply.erpRule: Orders are tracked here for stock planning. Invoices and accounting postings stay in the ERP.
supply.receiveRule: A goods receipt adds stock through a receipt movement. Rejected quantities never enter on-hand stock.
supply.grnLinesSub: Received, accepted and rejected per line
supply.consignmentRule: Consignment and supplier-owned stock is counted but is not your stock value. Cost reaches the books only through the ERP.

inv.choose: Choose a Tyre or PMV engineer
inv.noCandidates: No approved user holds a Tyre or PMV Engineering role. Give one person that role in Console, Users first.
inv.needFinding: Record at least one finding before proposing a correction.
inv.proposeRule: Proposing sends an approval request to an independent PMV Manager. You cannot approve your own proposal. Tyre records are not changed from here.
inv.waiting: Waiting for an independent PMV Manager to approve or reject the proposal.

tyres.syncHint: Re-reads tyre records and scrap marks. Tyre records are never changed.
tyres.decisionRule: This records your decision on the conflict only. Tyre records and scrap marks are not changed from here.
tyres.investigationRule: A scrapped but active tyre is investigated, not decided here: a Tyre or PMV engineer is assigned, records findings and proposes a correction, an independent PMV Manager approves it, and the case is closed as a decision. The tyre team then applies the correction in tyre records.
tyres.rule: Each tyre has exactly one custody state, derived from tyre records without changing them. Time in stock is not running life, so no km or life is shown here.
tyres.conflictsSub: Tyres whose records disagree, for example scrapped yet still fitted
tyres.search: Search serial, asset, brand or size
tyres.noAutoFix: This is not corrected automatically. An authorised person decides, with this evidence, which record is right.
tyres.noEvidence: No evidence was attached to this conflict.

ident.lookupSub: Scan or type a bin label, item code, barcode or cross-reference
ident.partial: Some lookups are not set up yet, so results may be incomplete.
ident.nothing: Nothing in inventory matches this code.
ident.labelsSub: Print QR labels for bins and assets
ident.compatSub: OEM references and fitments approved by engineering
ident.noCompatBody: No approved OEM reference or fitment exists yet, so no part is suggested as compatible. Nothing is matched by description.
ident.compatNotSetUp: The compatibility tables are not set up yet.

valuation.pendingAllocation: {qty} units left a balance that held both known and unknown cost, so how many were at known cost is undecided. They are counted on their own, never as valued or as zero, and the valuation stays incomplete until the split is decided in Cost reconciliation.
valuation.incompleteNote: Some owned stock has no known cost. The amount shown is the valued part only, not the total. Reconcile the missing costs to complete it.
valuation.fromBalances: The valuation view is not installed yet, so these figures are worked out from the balance lines.
valuation.byCurrencySub: Each currency on its own; currencies are never added together.
valuation.mixed: Values are listed per currency. They are never added together.
valuation.unvaluedNote: {n} lines have no cost. They are counted as unvalued, not as zero.
valuation.method: Weighted average cost per item, calculated by the database. Serialised tyres keep their own purchase price. This value is never added to the ERP expense figures and creates no posting.
valuation.bySiteSub: Every stock line with its valued and unvalued quantity. Only owned stock counts in the totals above.

sim.invalid: Fix these inputs before the scenario can run: {fields}. Years must be a whole number of 1 or more.
sim.failed: The scenario could not be calculated with these inputs. Check the values and try again.
sim.title: Investment and stocking-strategy scenario
sim.sub: Compare buying in bulk, holding stock, supplier-managed stock, consignment or a framework price, over the same demand
sim.label: Scenario (modelled, not an actual saving). Every value you type is an assumption.
sim.missing: Enter the required inputs to model both strategies: {fields}.
sim.incomplete: Both strategies need the same currency and their required inputs.
sim.notSaving: A positive difference means the alternative costs less in the model under these inputs. Working capital released is cash not tied up in owned stock; neither figure is an actual saving.

planning.replenishmentSub: Suggested order quantities from actual usage
planning.signalsSub: Available stock (on hand minus reserved) against the reorder point set for the line
planning.noSignals: No line is at or below its reorder point.
planning.simNoData: Brand-change and part-substitution scenarios need validated compatibility. None exists yet, so no scenario is offered.
planning.simReady: {n} validated compatibility records are available for scenarios.
planning.simHonesty: Scenarios are hypothetical and are never shown as actual savings.

reports.title: Inventory reports
reports.sub: Each file carries a report reference, its filters and the snapshot time
reports.notSetUp: This report's data is not set up yet.
reports.currencyRule: Money columns always sit beside their currency. Totals across currencies are never calculated.

approvals.rule: Adjustment posting, opening balance approval, recount assignment and cost reconciliation each need an approved request first. Ask for approval where the evidence is; another person decides it here; then the posting step applies exactly what was approved. The database decides who may decide and says why when you cannot.
approvals.queueSub: Requests waiting for a decision. Decide is offered only when the database says you may.
approvals.requested: Approval requested. It now appears in the approvals queue.
approvals.alreadyRequested: This approval was already requested; nothing new was sent.
approvals.decideRule: You cannot approve your own request or a record you counted, prepared or proposed. A rejection needs a reason.
approvals.rejectNeedsNote: A rejection needs a reason in the note.

costRecon.splitHint: The rest of the units stay at unknown cost and get their own cost reconciliation. Give evidence or a reason.
costRecon.decidedSplit: Decided: {valued} at known cost, {unvalued} at unknown cost.
costRecon.heldElsewhere: The undecided units travelled with a transfer; the split also settles the receiving balance.
costRecon.snapshotUnvalued: Balance at unknown cost before the movement
costRecon.snapshotValued: Balance at known cost before the movement
costRecon.allocationRule: These units left a balance that held both known and unknown cost. Nothing assumed which units went. Decide from evidence (batch, receipt, GRN) how many were at known cost. A split cannot be written off.
costRecon.title: Cost reconciliations
costRecon.rule: Stock that moved without a known cost is listed here. Unknown cost becomes known only through these three steps: propose the evidenced cost (or a write-off), another person approves it, then post it. A cost is never assumed and never zero.
costRecon.empty: No cost reconciliation for this filter.

kinds.issue_allocation: Split undecided on a mixed balance

costRecon.readOnly: You can see this reconciliation but not propose a cost.
costRecon.closedNote: This reconciliation is closed. Nothing more can be posted on it.
costRecon.consumedNote: These units were already issued. The approved cost is recorded for them; it does not change the stock still on hand.
costRecon.creatorNote: You raised this record, so you cannot post its resolution. Someone else must post it after approval.
costRecon.step2Body: Another person decides the proposal in Controls > Approvals. The status above shows where it stands.
costRecon.source: Reason or source of the cost
costRecon.noZero: A blank cost is refused rather than sent as zero. A cost of zero is accepted only with evidence, for example a free-of-charge delivery note.
costRecon.needsFinancialPost: Posting needs the financial posting permission.

erp.title: ERP reconciliation
erp.rule: Read-only comparison of inventory issues with the ERP issue lines, per month, site, item and currency. Nothing here posts to the ERP or changes stock; differences are investigated, not auto-corrected. Matching is by item code text.
erp.empty: No reconciliation lines for these filters.

flows.noJobCard: No job card given: the movement will not be linked to a job card.
flows.shortfallWarn: Only {available} available for {requested} requested. The server will refuse the issue and record a shortage.
flows.returnNeedsReason: Give a reason to return stock.
flows.returnUnvalued: A return comes back at unknown cost and opens a cost reconciliation; no value is assumed.
flows.overReceived: A received quantity is more than what is still in transit.
flows.nothingToReceive: Enter a received quantity above zero on at least one line.
flows.zeroStaysInTransit: A line left at 0 is not received and stays in transit.
flows.returnTransferSub: Everything still in transit goes back to the source location. Both sides post to the ledger.
flows.crossSiteScope: The destination site is outside your site scope. Stock in transit is held at the destination, so the server will refuse this dispatch. Ask someone with access to both sites.
flows.movedPendingNote: The undecided part is recorded for a person to decide from evidence; no value was assumed for it.
flows.movedSplit: Moved at known cost: {valued}. Moved at unknown cost: {unvalued}. Split undecided: {pending}.
flows.movedUnvaluedNote: The part at unknown cost has an open cost reconciliation; the value moved covers the known part only.
flows.replayed: Already posted with this request; nothing was posted twice.
flows.shortageBody: Stock cannot go negative. Nothing was posted and a shortage exception was recorded for follow-up.
flows.receiveSub: Accepted quantity enters stock at the location; rejected quantity never does.
flows.itemSearch: Type 2+ characters of the item code
flows.stockSearch: Type 2+ characters of the item code
flows.blankCost: Leave the cost blank when it is not known: the stock is kept as unvalued, never priced at zero.
flows.reserveIssueSub: Hold stock for a job card, then issue it. Reserved stock stays on hand until issued.
flows.sourceReceiptAuto: Not named (only allowed when the item is not serial or lot tracked)
flows.sourceReceiptHint: For a serial or lot tracked item whose stock mixes known and unknown cost, choose the receipt the units came from.
flows.noNegative: Stock never goes negative. A request larger than the available quantity is refused and recorded.
flows.transferRule: A transfer moves stock to an in-transit location on dispatch and into the destination when it is received. A short receipt stays in transit until it is received or returned.
flows.dispatchSub: Choose the two locations and the stock lines to send.
flows.receiveTransferSub: Enter what actually arrived. Anything not received stays in transit.

kpis.title: Inventory KPIs
kpis.lead: The inventory KPI catalogue for the selected country and site. Stock value and discrepancies are on the Overview. Every figure states its period; a figure that cannot be measured says why.
kpis.someFailed: {n} data source(s) could not be loaded; the KPIs that depend on them say so.
kpis.valueHiddenNote: Money figures are hidden: you need the view value permission for stock.

groupSub.availability: Can stores meet demand right now.
groupSub.accuracy: From the latest physical count that reached reconciliation.
groupSub.value: Owned stock only. Balance-sheet value, never part of CPK or cost per m3.
groupSub.supplier: Orders placed in the selected period.

unit.pctBook: Percent and book value per currency

state.loadFailed: Could not load the data for this KPI.
state.notSetUp: The data for this KPI is not set up yet.

inv_critical_availability.label: Critical item availability
inv_critical_availability.def: Vital items whose available quantity (on hand minus reserved) is at or above safety stock, or above zero when no safety stock is set, out of all vital items held at this scope.

inv_stockout_frequency.label: Stock-out frequency
inv_stockout_frequency.def: Requests that could not be met from stock (recorded shortages and backorders) out of all requests with a known outcome (issues posted plus shortages) in the period.

inv_reserved_not_issued.label: Reserved but not issued
inv_reserved_not_issued.def: Quantity still reserved and not issued on active reservations older than 14 days, with its value per currency.

inv_accuracy_exact_line.label: Inventory accuracy (exact line)
inv_accuracy_exact_line.def: Counted lines whose count matches the expected quantity within tolerance, out of all counted lines in the latest count. Serial-tracked lines have zero tolerance.

inv_accuracy_quantity.label: Inventory accuracy (quantity)
inv_accuracy_quantity.def: One minus the total absolute variance divided by the total expected quantity in the latest count.

inv_accuracy_serial.label: Serial accuracy
inv_accuracy_serial.def: Serials found where expected, out of all serials expected or found in the latest count. Missing and unexpected serials both count against it.

inv_gross_shortage.label: Gross shortage
inv_gross_shortage.def: Total quantity counted below expected in the latest count, and its value per currency at the snapshot cost. Shown separately from excess.

inv_gross_excess.label: Gross excess
inv_gross_excess.def: Total quantity counted above expected in the latest count, and its value per currency at the snapshot cost. Shown separately from shortage.

inv_count_completion.label: Count completion
inv_count_completion.def: Lines counted or confirmed zero, out of all lines in the scope of the latest count.

inv_unvalued_stock.label: Unvalued stock
inv_unvalued_stock.def: Owned stock lines (and their quantity) with no known cost. Zero is a real answer.

inv_adjustment_value.label: Adjustment value
inv_adjustment_value.def: Net value of approved count adjustments in the period per currency, with the gross gain and gross loss beside it.

inv_turnover.label: Inventory turnover
inv_turnover.def: Valued issues in the last 12 months divided by the average month-end stock value, per currency. Month-end values are rebuilt from the stock ledger.

inv_dio.label: Days inventory outstanding
inv_dio.def: Days in the period divided by turnover, per currency.

inv_dead_stock.label: Dead stock
inv_dead_stock.def: Value of owned stock with no issue in 365 days and no open reservation. Lines with too little history are counted as unknown, not dead.

inv_slow_stock.label: Slow-moving stock
inv_slow_stock.def: Value of owned stock whose last issue was 180 to 364 days ago.

inv_excess_stock.label: Excess stock
inv_excess_stock.def: Value of the owned quantity above the item maximum. Lines without a maximum are counted as unknown.

inv_obsolescence_exposure.label: Obsolescence exposure
inv_obsolescence_exposure.def: Value of owned stock whose item is marked obsolete in the item master.

inv_supplier_otif.label: Supplier delivery performance (OTIF)
inv_supplier_otif.def: Purchase order lines received on or before the expected delivery date and in full, out of all lines that were due, for orders placed in the period.

inv_lead_time_variance.label: Lead-time variance
inv_lead_time_variance.def: Average of actual lead days (order date to first receipt) minus the agreed lead time from the active supplier agreement, for orders placed in the period.

inv_outstanding_po_qty.label: Outstanding PO quantity
inv_outstanding_po_qty.def: Quantity ordered and not yet received on open purchase order lines placed in the period, with its value per currency at the order price.

inv_consignment_utilisation.label: Consignment utilisation
inv_consignment_utilisation.def: Consigned quantity issued in the period divided by the consigned quantity held now, per active consignment agreement.

inv_emergency_purchase_rate.label: Emergency purchase rate
inv_emergency_purchase_rate.def: Purchase orders with an emergency or urgent priority out of all orders placed in the period (cancelled excluded), with the emergency value share per currency.

inv_purchase_avoidance.label: Purchase avoidance
inv_purchase_avoidance.def: Requests met from stock or reusable stock instead of buying, out of all resolved requests. The value is the book value of stock used, not a saving.

reason.not_measurable: Cannot be measured from the data in scope.
reason.mixed_currency: More than one currency in scope: see each currency below; currencies are never added together.
reason.no_valued_data: No stock with a known cost in scope.
reason.value_incomplete: Some lines have no known cost, so the total cannot be stated.
reason.now_required: Cannot be measured without the current date.
reason.mixed_units: Lines use different units of measure, so quantities cannot be added.
reason.fewer_than_3_complete_snapshots: Needs 3 complete month-end values; the stock ledger does not cover enough months yet.
reason.average_stock_value_zero: Average stock value is zero, so turnover cannot be calculated.
reason.issue_value_incomplete: Some issues have no known cost.
reason.issue_coverage_below_80pct: Less than 80% of issued quantity has a known cost.
reason.turnover_zero: Turnover is zero, so days outstanding cannot be calculated.
reason.no_data: No issues or stock values in scope.
reason.expected_total_zero: The latest count expected no stock, so quantity accuracy cannot be calculated.
reason.no_adjustments: No approved adjustments in the period.
reason.no_consigned_stock_held: No consigned stock is held under the active agreements.
reason.no_counted_lines: The latest count has no counted lines yet.
reason.no_lines_due: No purchase order lines were due yet (none received and none past the expected delivery date).
reason.no_lines_in_scope: The latest count has no lines in scope.
reason.no_purchase_orders: No purchase orders in the period.
reason.no_received_line_with_agreed_lead_time: No received line has an agreed lead time (set it on the supplier agreement).
reason.no_requests_with_known_outcome: No requests with a known outcome in the period.
reason.no_resolved_requests: No resolved requests in the period.
reason.no_vital_items: No item in scope is marked vital in the item master (criticality not recorded).
reason.nothing_expected_or_found: The latest count had no serial-tracked lines.

empty.noStock: No stock balances recorded yet for {scope}.
empty.noRequests: No stock issues or recorded shortages yet for {scope} in this period.
empty.noCount: No physical count has reached reconciliation yet for {scope}.
empty.noSerialCount: The latest count for {scope} had no serial-tracked lines.
empty.noAdjustments: No approved count adjustments recorded yet for {scope} in this period.
empty.noMovements: No stock movements recorded yet for {scope} in the last 12 months.
empty.noOrders: No purchase orders recorded yet for {scope} in this period.
empty.noPoLines: Purchase orders for {scope} in this period have no lines recorded.
empty.fulfilmentNotRecorded: Not recorded yet: requests do not record whether they were met from stock or by buying, so this cannot be measured for {scope}.

classify.title: Stock classification

review.method: Proposals for items with no brand or no part type, read from the item description. ORIGINAL or ORG means genuine (OEM). OEM# is a part number label and the -O code ending is not evidence. LOCAL, CHINA and TAIWAN count only when written. Brands come only from existing brand lists. Nothing changes until a second person approves it.
review.readOnly: You can see the proposals but not send them. Sending needs counting or approval rights.
review.title: Proposals to review

blocked.conflict: Two answers in the text. Decide by hand.
blocked.local_not_storable: Local cannot be saved yet. The database allows genuine, OES and aftermarket only.
blocked.pending: A change for this item is already waiting for approval.

review.sentOne: {sku} sent for approval. A second person must approve it.
review.empty: No proposals. Every item either has a brand and part type, or its description states neither.
review.footnote: Reject hides a proposal on this device only. Sent proposals appear in Corrections or variant approvals, where a different person approves or rejects them.

method.abc: Items ranked by valued issue value in the last 12 months, inside one currency. A: up to {a}% of cumulative value, B: up to {b}%, C: the rest. An item with unknown value is unclassified, never C.
method.fsn: Months with at least one issue in the last {window}. F: {fast} or more months, S: 1 or more, N: none across the full window. Items or ledgers younger than the window are unclassified.
method.ved: From the criticality recorded in the item master: V vital, E essential, D desirable. Not recorded is unassessed, never D. A vital item that does not move is a critical insurance spare, not dead stock.

classify.search: Search item code, name or category
classify.empty: No stocked items or stock issues recorded yet for {scope}.
classify.valueHidden: Consumption values are hidden: you need the view value permission for stock.

reason.consumption_value_unknown: Consumption value unknown (an issue has no cost or issues are in more than one currency).
reason.no_consumption_in_period: No issues in the last 12 months.
reason.now_required: Cannot be classified without the current date.
reason.item_younger_than_window: Item is newer than the 12-month window.
reason.ledger_shorter_than_window: The stock ledger is shorter than 12 months, so non-moving cannot be proven yet.
reason.criticality_not_recorded: Criticality not recorded in the item master.
reason.history_unavailable: The stock ledger could not be read, so value and movement cannot be classified.
reason.item_master_unavailable: The item master could not be read, so criticality is unknown.

pi.title: Physical inventory
pi.lead: Register what is physically on the shelves. A capture is evidence and never changes official stock: identified items go to an opening-balance batch that another person approves.

start.title: Start physical inventory
start.sub: Pick the store and, if you know it, the warehouse, rack, shelf or bin.
start.pickCountry: Choose a single country in the working context first.
start.noLocations: This store has no locations yet. Ask an inventory manager to create its warehouse, racks and bins under Locations. You can still record captures with a location note.

sessions.title: Physical inventory sessions
sessions.sub: Open sessions can be resumed on any device.
sessions.prepared: Opening-balance batch prepared with {n} lines; {skipped} captures left out (not identified or no ERP SKU).
sessions.ledgerRule: Official stock only changes when the opening-balance batch is approved by someone other than its preparer (Controls > Opening balances). Missing prices stay unvalued for Finance.

capture.frozenNote: This item was not confirmed by the server. Saving again sends exactly the same item (no duplicate). Changes you make now are not included; discard it only if you are sure it was not saved.
capture.discardFrozen: Discard and start a new item
capture.photosKept: {n} photos did not upload and are kept here.
capture.title: Capture
capture.sub: Scan or type a barcode, company SKU, OEM or aftermarket number, or search by manufacturer or description. Save and go to the next item.
capture.codePlaceholder: Scan or type a code, part number or description
capture.noMatch: No approved material matches. Describe the item below and save it; it gets a temporary reference for review.
capture.unidentifiedHint: Price, purchase order and full identification are not needed to save. Unidentified items cannot be issued until they are identified and approved.
capture.photosFailed: {n} photos could not be uploaded. Attach them again from Identification review.

err.quantity: Enter a quantity of zero or more.

materials.title: Materials waiting for approval
materials.sub: A proposal from any store is checked against every record of the company. After approval it can be selected at every authorised location.
materials.addVariantSub: A manufacturer's version of an approved material. Stock and cost stay separate per variant.
materials.linkSub: Map a country ERP item to the material or variant. Country ERP numbers are kept as they are.
materials.bulkSub: Approves up to 500 proposed items per press, oldest first. Items you proposed yourself are skipped: a different person must approve them.
materials.bulkReason: Why these are new items (needed when duplicates are flagged)
materials.bulkConfirm: Approve up to {n} proposed items now? Each still passes the normal checks.

corr.title: Master-data corrections
corr.sub: Every change is a request with evidence, approved by a different person. Historical and financial records are never changed.
corr.ownNote: You raised this request, so someone else must decide it.
corr.newSub: Find the material, then describe the change and give evidence.

search.title: Material search
search.sub: One search across company SKUs, ERP SKUs, OEM and aftermarket numbers, barcodes, descriptions, manufacturers and validated compatibility.
search.placeholder: Part number, SKU, barcode, manufacturer or description
search.avail: {a} available, {r} reserved, {it} in transit, {d} damaged, {q} quarantined
search.unassigned: Stock not assigned to a variant
search.transferSent: Transfer requested. The sending store decides it.
search.pickStore: Choose your store in the site filter to request a transfer instead of buying again.

rules.genuine: Genuine and OES need evidence such as an invoice, catalogue or manufacturer confirmation. An OEM number printed on packaging is not proof.
rules.reviewer: Identification keeps the original quantity, location, photos and the counter's name.
rules.corrections: Corrections only change identification data. Stock, ledger, ERP records and costs are never edited from here.

transfers.title: Transfer requests
transfers.sub: Requests from other stores for stock you hold. The sending store approves or rejects; the requester can cancel.
transfers.rule: Approving a request does not move stock. Dispatch it through Stock flows > Transfer.

oemx.title: OEM cross-reference
oemx.sub: Link OEM manual part numbers to company materials. A person decides every link.
oemx.closedNote: Compares every parsed OEM manual row with the catalogue OEM numbers, variant part numbers and descriptions. Opens on request because it reads the whole catalogue.
oemx.rule: Exact part-number matches only, after removing spaces, dashes, dots and slashes. High: equal to a recorded OEM number or variant part number. Medium: equal to a part number found in the description as imported. An OEM number that matches several materials is shown as a conflict for a person to choose. Nothing is linked until you accept it, and a second person must approve each link.
oemx.summary: {total} OEM part numbers from {rows} of {entries} manual rows have a proposal: {high} high, {medium} medium, {conflict} conflicts.
oemx.truncated: A read was capped, so some proposals may be missing.
oemx.empty: No OEM manual row matches a catalogue number exactly. Nothing to review.

erp.missing: No ERP item with this SKU in this country

oemx.dismissHint: Hides this suggestion on this screen only. It is not saved, because nothing is stored yet.
oemx.ownProposal: You proposed this link. Another person must decide it.
oemx.doneSubmitted: Link submitted. It waits for a second person to approve it.
